name: aurora-chunking-seed
description: Seed retrieval set for the Phase 3b chunking benchmark. Evidence is verbatim text from the samples; a fact counts as retrieved when one retrieved chunk contains any of its alternatives (whitespace-normalised). Phase 12 extends this to the full >=100-question LangSmith dataset.
